title: modify_requirement.v1
description: Input for slot T-MINT: mint a sitting item from a construct × hinge requirement. JEV plans the form; a writer generates; G17 and unbiased JEV classify gate release. Teacher-side. Never contains API keys.

requirement_id.description: Session-scoped id. Never an exam.v1 freeze uid.

target_construct.description: Requested construct cell, e.g. An.Co.3. Release still requires unbiased JEV admission; this field is a brief, not a stamp.

unit_id.description: Map unit to bind before T-PLAN. When omitted, hinge_id is resolved to a unit whose zone contains target_construct.

intent.description: What the item should discriminate. Teacher-side only; never printed on the stem.

accept_neighbour.description: Legacy flag. Mint no longer retargets before the writer. An admitted cell is kept only when it is inside the bound unit zone.
